# ghost/habit-tracker

Loop Habit Tracker (F-Droid): create a yes/no habit, tick or untick a day, list habits and read a habit's score and total count. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/habit-tracker
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/habit-tracker create_habit --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/habit-tracker check_habit --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/habit-tracker get_habits --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/habit-tracker get_habit_stats --device <serial> --param name=<name>
```

## Actions

- `create_habit`: Create a habit called Meditate
- `check_habit`: Mark Meditate as done today
- `get_habits`: Which habits am I tracking?
- `get_habit_stats`: How is my Meditate habit going?
